## Personality

Thomas Sowerby is a quiet and small man. He is known to locals in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) primarily as "[Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) Sowerby's husband."

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Sowerby lacked willpower throughout his life, transitioning from being commanded by his mother to being led by his wife, [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), after his marriage. Following his eventual death, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposed inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P37](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0037)_

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--thomas-sowerby.md)

Thomas Sowerby was the husband of [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) until his death. Following his passing, the community arranged for his widowed wife to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to assist with local household transitions.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), +11 more_
